"""Replay an actual fitted population for Nsight Compute; no optimizer changes."""
import argparse,json,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import psyneulink as pnl
import torch
from dawa_fitting_budget_study import Study
from dawa_pec_fit import LAUNCH,load_subject
from psyneulink.core.batched.shifted_histogram import ShiftedHistogramScorer

p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--run',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--estimates',type=int,default=100000)
p.add_argument('--evaluation',type=int,default=1002)
p.add_argument('--candidates',type=int,default=10)
p.add_argument('--repeats',type=int,default=3)
a=p.parse_args()
pnl.set_num_threads(8);torch.set_num_threads(8)
m=json.loads((a.run/'manifest.json').read_text())
f=load_subject(a.run/'synthetic_subject.csv',m['arguments']['subject'])
s=Study(f,m['arguments']['max_steps'])
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (a.run/'evaluations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
selected=[row for row in rows if a.evaluation<=row['evaluation']<a.evaluation+a.candidates]
assert len(selected)==a.candidates
parameters=[row['parameters'].copy() for row in selected]
for row in parameters:row[1]=0.
support=np.arange(s.plan.ir.max_steps+1,dtype=np.float32)*np.float32(.01)
scorer=ShiftedHistogramScorer(support,np.linspace(.1,.3,2001),s.observed,[0],bins=100,bin_range=[(0.,3.)],smoothing_sigma=.5,categorical_cardinalities=[2])
paramsets=s.parameters(parameters)
durations=[]
for repeat in range(a.repeats+1):
 torch.cuda.synchronize();start=time.perf_counter()
 reduced=s.plan.discrete_output_counts(s.inputs,paramsets,a.estimates,s.observed,[0],support=support,
  seed=37,invalid_candidates='nan',triton_launch_options=LAUNCH)
 density=scorer.densities(reduced,pseudocount=a.estimates/100000)
 torch.cuda.synchronize()
 durations.append(time.perf_counter()-start)
r={'evaluation':a.evaluation,'candidates':a.candidates,'estimates':a.estimates,'seconds_including_warmup':durations,
 'valid_candidates':reduced.valid_candidates.tolist(),'launch':LAUNCH,'gpu':torch.cuda.get_device_name(),
 'mean_density':np.nanmean(density).item()}
a.output.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))

"""Timing-only experiment: identical independent blocks, sequential or on CUDA streams."""
import argparse,json,time,statistics
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import psyneulink as pnl
import torch
from dawa_fitting_budget_study import Study
from dawa_pec_fit import LAUNCH,load_subject
from psyneulink.core.batched.shifted_histogram import ShiftedHistogramScorer

p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--run',type=Path,required=True);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
a=p.parse_args();pnl.set_num_threads(8);torch.set_num_threads(8)
m=json.loads((a.run/'manifest.json').read_text());s=Study(load_subject(a.run/'synthetic_subject.csv',m['arguments']['subject']),2000)
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (a.run/'evaluations.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
selected=[row for row in rows if 1002<=row['evaluation']<1012]
parameters=[row['parameters'].copy() for row in selected]
for row in parameters:row[1]=0.
paramsets=s.parameters(parameters);support=np.arange(2001,dtype=np.float32)*np.float32(.01)
scorer=ShiftedHistogramScorer(support,np.linspace(.1,.3,2001),s.observed,[0],bins=100,bin_range=[(0.,3.)],smoothing_sigma=.5,categorical_cardinalities=[2])
# Calibrate Python-profiler hot spots without cProfile or Nsight instrumentation.
from psyneulink.core.batched.backend.triton.discrete_counts import DiscreteCountEmitter
from psyneulink.core.batched.kernel_ir import validate_kernel_ir
from psyneulink.core.batched.prep import normalize_parameter_sets
host_probe={}
for label,func in {
 'validate_ir':lambda:validate_kernel_ir(s.plan.kernel_ir),
 'emit_including_validation':lambda:DiscreteCountEmitter(s.plan.kernel_ir,[0,1],[True,False],support_size=len(support),normal_rng=LAUNCH['normal_rng'],trial_schedule=LAUNCH['trial_schedule'],stop_truncated=True).emit(),
 'normalize_parameters':lambda:normalize_parameter_sets(paramsets,s.plan.ir),
}.items():
 func();measurements=[]
 for _ in range(30):
  start=time.perf_counter();func();measurements.append(time.perf_counter()-start)
 host_probe[label]={'seconds':measurements,'median_seconds':statistics.median(measurements)}
print(json.dumps({'host_probe':host_probe}),flush=True)
streams=[torch.cuda.Stream() for _ in range(4)]
def block(spec):
 k,n,parallel=spec
 def work():
  counts=s.plan.discrete_output_counts(s.inputs,paramsets,n,s.observed,[0],support=support,seed=7411+k,
   invalid_candidates='nan',triton_launch_options=LAUNCH)
  return scorer.densities(counts,pseudocount=n/100000)
 if parallel:
  with torch.cuda.stream(streams[k]):return work()
 return work()
results=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 for n,b in [(1250,4),(2500,2),(10000,2)]:
  # Warm all kernels before concurrent use; stream inputs are immutable.
  ref=[block((k,n,False)) for k in range(b)]
  torch.cuda.synchronize()
  par=list(pool.map(block,[(k,n,True) for k in range(b)]))
  for x,y in zip(ref,par,strict=True):np.testing.assert_array_equal(x,y)
  timing={'sequential':[],'concurrent':[]}
  for repeat in range(5):
   for mode in (['sequential','concurrent'] if repeat%2==0 else ['concurrent','sequential']):
    torch.cuda.synchronize();t=time.perf_counter()
    if mode=='sequential':values=[block((k,n,False)) for k in range(b)]
    else:values=list(pool.map(block,[(k,n,True) for k in range(b)]))
    torch.cuda.synchronize();timing[mode].append(time.perf_counter()-t)
  record={'estimates_per_block':n,'blocks':b,'candidates':10,'exact_density_equality':True,'seconds':timing,
   'median_speedup':statistics.median(timing['sequential'])/statistics.median(timing['concurrent'])}
  results.append(record);print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
a.output.write_text(json.dumps({'results':results,'host_probe':host_probe,'note':'Warm microbenchmark on one actual population; no fit policy changed.'},indent=2)+'\n')

limitations: Python/Nsight instrumentation increases host time; use the previous uninstrumented fit for throughput.
Source instruction sampling is not exclusive wall-time attribution.
Concurrent blocks are a timing experiment on one actual population; no full fit uses this optimization yet.
A 100k Nsight Compute run was stopped because counter replay was slow; hardware comparisons use 1250 and 20000, with full-fit 100k timings retained in Nsight Systems.
An initial concurrency run on GPU0 was excluded after other GPU processes appeared; reported microbenchmarks use a monitored repeat on GPU1.
Cold first-call gaps include JIT and other first-use work; they are not an exclusive compiler timer.
No production compiler, model, estimator, or adaptive policy was changed by this profiling task.
